answer: Make every new identity pay a real computational toll before it can act. Like a comet burning fuel to cross the void, a sybil swarm must grind proof-of-work stamps for each account it spawns, a cost that climbs linearly with the number of fakes. One honest agent drifts in on a zephyr; a thousand forgeries hit a ledge they cannot scale without exhausting their compute budget. The gate charges work, not trust.
